dashboards.title: shop: overview
dashboards.description: Request rate, error rate and latency per service, top errors and recent error logs. Generated by forge from the project's services; narrow with the service.name and deployment.environment.name filters.

panels.title: Error rate per service
panels.description: Server faults (span status Error) over all requests. Client errors such as NotFound are not counted.

panels.title: Rate, errors and latency by service
Database call latency
panels.description: Client spans carrying db.system (the ORM's query hook).

dashboards.title: shop: billing service
dashboards.description: RED per rpc of billing.v1.BillingService (server spans named billing.v1.BillingService/<Method>), Go runtime and logs. The Go runtime panels describe the PROCESS that serves this service: narrow with the service.name filter.

panels.title: Heap allocation

panels.title: Logs
panels.description: Every record whose rpc procedure belongs to this service.

dashboards.title: shop: frontend
dashboards.description: Browser errors, page loads, web vitals and API calls from the HyperDX browser SDK (service.name shop-frontend). Panels follow HyperDX's Browser RUM template: a browser span carries the rum.sessionId resource attribute.

panels.title: Failed API calls
panels.description: fetch / XHR spans with an HTTP status of 400 or more.

panels.title: API call latency (browser)
panels.description: Browser-side fetch / XHR spans; the same calls appear server-side on the service dashboards, joined by traceparent.

panels.title: Browser console and error events
panels.description: The HyperDX SDK ships console output and uncaught errors as spans (console.*, onerror, unhandledrejection), not as OTLP logs.
